q: Time is measured in years, months, days, hours, minutes and seconds, but the SI unit for time is the _____.
e: Time is measured in years, months, days, hours, minutes and seconds, but the SI unit for time is the second (s). SI writes every quantity as a number times an agreed unit involving months.

q: Most common modern clocks and watches depend on the vibration of _____ crystals to keep time accurately.
e: Most common modern clocks and watches depend on the vibration of quartz crystals to keep time accurately. The physics in this sentence is built around quartz.

q: The energy to keep quartz crystals vibrating comes from a small _____.
e: The energy to keep quartz crystals vibrating comes from a small battery. The physics in this sentence is built around battery.

q: A stopwatch or a stop clock can be chosen to measure the time to an accuracy of a few _____ of a second.
e: A stopwatch or a stop clock can be chosen to measure the time to an accuracy of a few tenths of a second. The physics in this sentence is built around tenths.

q: Digital stopwatches can measure up to an accuracy of _____.
e: Digital stopwatches can measure up to an accuracy of $0.01\text{ s}$. The physics in this sentence is built around $0.01\text{ s}$.
